title: Normalize region identifiers in metrics pipeline (canonical mapping + normalized_region tag)
author: Mei Lin
release_notes: Internal-only telemetry change: adds normalized_region dimension for unit economics aggregation. No API surface changes.
description:
Context: The Unit Economics dashboard (ENG-8426) requires stable grouping by region, but today we emit a mix of cloud region strings (e.g., "us-east-1"), internal colo labels (e.g., "iad-1"), and provider-specific variants (e.g., "eu-west" vs "eu-west-1"). This causes dropped rows in aggregation (joins fail), duplicate region groups in dashboards, and inconsistent reconciliation vs Finance rate cards.

This PR introduces a canonical region mapping and updates ingestion so analytics receives a single, normalized region dimension.

What’s included: (1) Canonical region mapping table + versioned source-of-truth (2) Ingestion changes to emit `normalized_region` (and preserve raw `region` for debugging) (3) Guardrails for unknown/unmapped regions (4) Backfill-friendly behavior and unit tests.

Design notes: - The mapping is intentionally small and stable; we do NOT map down to per-AZ. - We keep `region_raw`/`region_source` so oncall can debug mapping mistakes without digging through gateway logs. - Unknown mappings are emitted as `unknown` and counted (metric + log) instead of dropping events, to avoid silent undercounting.

Implementation details: - Added `region_canonical_map` (warehouse + service config) keyed by (provider, region_raw) -> normalized_region. - Updated metrics pipeline ingestion (gateway + runtime collector) to call `normalizeRegion(provider, regionRaw)` and attach `normalized_region` tag on all token metering events. - Added a daily diff check in CI to detect accidental drift in the mapping table (mostly for typos / duplicate keys).

Example mapping entry (illustrative): provider=aws, region_raw=eu-west -> normalized_region=aws/eu-west-1; provider=internal, region_raw=iad-1 -> normalized_region=internal/us-east.

Rollout plan: - Deploy behind feature flag `metrics.normalized_region.enabled` default off. - Enable for 5% of hosted traffic in us-east + eu-west, validate that (a) event volume stays flat, (b) unknown_region_count < 0.1%, (c) unit econ aggregation join coverage improves. - Ramp to 100% hosted, then dedicated/private collectors.

Validation: - Compared pre/post event counts by hour: within ±0.2%. - Verified no increase in tag cardinality (normalized values are constrained).

Follow-ups: - Once roll-out completes, update unit economics views to prefer `normalized_region` and only fall back to raw for legacy windows (separate PR in ENG-8426 branch).
commits: metrics: add canonical region mapping config + loader
ingestion: emit normalized_region tag on token metering events
warehouse: add region_canonical_map seed + validation query
tests: add normalization unit tests + unknown region counters
docs: update telemetry dimension spec for region normalization
conversation:
Nadia Rahman (review): Can you confirm we’re not changing the meaning of “region” for existing dashboards? I’m worried about breaking existing ad-hoc queries that group on region.

Mei Lin (author): Yep. We keep the existing `region` tag as-is and add `normalized_region` as a new tag. Existing dashboards will continue grouping on `region` until we migrate them (separate PR). Also added `region_source` so we can see whether the raw value came from gateway vs runtime collector.

Caleb Johnson (review): Please add explicit metrics for unknown/unmapped region occurrences. We’ve had issues where join failures silently drop rows.

Mei Lin (author): Added `metrics.region_normalization.unknown_region_count` + structured log with provider/region_raw (sampled) when unknown. Also changed join behavior in the prototype view to left-join and surface `unknown` rather than drop.

Sean Gallagher (review): Rollout plan looks good but we should be careful about tag cardinality. Are you constraining normalized_region values?

Mei Lin (author): Yes. Normalized values come from a CSV checked into repo + schema validation on load. Unknown collapses to a single value `unknown`. CI includes a cardinality test that asserts normalized_region cardinality <= 64 in staging fixtures.

Allison Grant (review): Can you add a note about day-boundary/timezone? Finance tends to report in UTC but some internal labels have local-time semantics.

Mei Lin (author): Added a note in docs: normalization only affects region labels, not timestamps; all pipeline aggregation remains UTC. Linked to the pipeline SLO doc section on UTC boundaries.

Cole Summers (review): For dedicated/private, provider may be “customer-managed” and region_raw might be empty. What happens?

Mei Lin (author): If provider missing/region_raw empty we emit normalized_region=`unknown` and set region_source=`missing`. That’s intentional so we can alert and work with deployments to populate the tag; we don’t want to fabricate a region.

Nadia Rahman (approval): Looks good after the unknown counter + docs updates. Approved.

Merge: Squashed and merged to main after CI green. Feature flag remains off by default; enabling tracked in ENG-8424 rollout checklist.
notes: This PR is part of the Unit Economics dashboard foundation work. It reduces duplicate region groups and prevents aggregation row drops caused by inconsistent region labels across gateway/runtime/infra billing sources.
